item.title: Self-Hosted Association & Membership Management: Admidio vs Galette vs Tendenci Compared 2026
item.description: Running a club, association, or nonprofit organization means managing members, dues, events, and communications — without getting buried in spreadsheets. Self-hosted membership management platforms give you full control over member data while keeping costs predictable.
